info.name: Hospital Management API - Final (by role)
info.description:
Hospital Management System - Spring Boot API (all endpoints from your code)

HOW TO TEST (in this order):
1. Admin login (folder 2, request 01). Admin and receptionist must already exist in the database (see seed_admin_receptionist.sql).
2. Admin > Departments > 01 Create, then 02 List (saves departmentId).
3. Folder 1: Register Patient, then Register Doctor.
4. Admin > Doctor Approval > 02 Approve Doctor.
5. Folder 2: login as Receptionist, Doctor, Patient (tokens are saved automatically).
6. Receptionist > Patients 02 (saves patientId), Admin > Doctors 01 (saves doctorId), then book appointments.
7. Doctor: create medical record, then prescription.
8. Patient: view own data. Then run folder 7 (blocked requests).

Variables (patientEmail, doctorEmail, usernames...) are in the collection Variables tab. Change them to create new users.
Dates: {{today}} and {{tomorrow}} are set automatically before every request.

exec: const f = x => x.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(x.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(x.getDate());

item.name: 1. Register (no token needed)

request.description: Patient is ACTIVE immediately and can log in. Password needs 6+ characters and 1 capital letter. Username 3-20 letters/numbers/underscore. Address fields are optional.
Doctor is PENDING. Needs an ACTIVE department (create one first as admin). Doctor can log in only after admin approves.
